address: 2C Quang Trung Street, Hoan Kiem Ward, Hanoi, 11006, Vietnam
bio: The TUNG-in-cheek acronym – twisted, unique, natural, gastronomic – encapsulates the philosophy of Chef Hoang Tung's culinary style. His tasting menu, which keeps pace with the seasons and uses local produce, boasts colourful, minimalist dishes, each of which features just 3 or 4 ingredients, whose complexity explodes with every bite. The flavours are balanced and well-judged, with contrasts of texture and temperature, and acidity often playing a key role....
